title: OpenAI GPT-6 family
summary: OpenAI's published scores for GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and the GPT-6.1 Sol claim. ChatGPT's GPT-6 control is a thinking slider over Sol and Astra, not a separate scored model.
howItCompiles: Astra scores come from the Astra launch page. The page says scores are the maximum at any effort unless a table names an effort.
Sol and Luna scores come from the 22 Sep 2026 Sol and Luna post, at the effort named in each row.
GPT-6.1 Sol's DeepSWE cell is derived. OpenAI printed a 6.4 point gain over GPT-6 Sol's best and did not print the absolute.
Competitor cells on these pages are quotes from other labs when OpenAI says so.
limits: None of GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, or GPT-6 Luna has a CursorBench row in the 13 Oct 2026 read.
A derived cell is not a number OpenAI printed.
